name: hcs-logs
description: Tamper-evident cargo records anchored on a Hedera Consensus Service topic, with HIP-991 submission fees paid in an HTS token

envVars.description: Network to use: testnet, mainnet or previewnet
Association treasury account: pays for setup, holds the Freight supply, collects fees
Treasury private key (DER, or 0x-prefixed ECDSA hex)
Infrastructure operator account, the second fee collector
Infrastructure operator private key, used once to associate Freight
The four committee representatives' private keys, comma-separated (local testing only)
Committee signatures required to change the fee (default 3)
Member company account that submits records and pays the fee
Freight token id, printed by token:create
Records topic id, printed by topic:create
Most Freight a member will pay per submission (default 1)
Optional mirror node override; defaults to the public one

steps.label: Generate throwaway keys for local testing
Get testnet HBAR for the treasury account
Create the Freight token, then set FREIGHT_TOKEN_ID in .env
Create the records topic with HIP-991 fees, then set TOPIC_ID in .env
Verify the parcel against the mirror node

steps.text: Edit any file under packages/nextjs/data/ and verify again: that record flips to changed.
